name: agent-card
title: Agent card
description: One unit of agent work (a run, a task, a job) as a collapsible card that keeps working in the background: a header with the agent's colour dot, a title, a status chip and one line of activity, an optional `meta` for a task's fields, a decision the agent waits for on the folded card, and the composer's levels (folded, a small tray, the whole chat, docked) on a controller strip on its lower border. A host that draws its own card passes `header` and `children`, a `slot` for the tray, an optional `controller` (with `onChatRequest`, so the conversation is made on the first tap) and a quiet `unread` dot.
